title: Dark Horse Momentum
next_chapter_hook: Ling Yuan's gaze was like the abyss staring, Chen Ji felt a chill rise from his tailbone—the eyes held a scrutiny that transcended master and disciple.

text.content: That jade slip lay quietly on the stone table, the yellowed surface bearing familiar characters that seemed to have traveled through ten years of time—those were the brushstrokes of his father, Chen Xuan. As the candlelight flickered, the characters appeared and disappeared intermittently. Chen Ji's fingers hovered above the jade slip, yet he delayed touching it. He knew that once he made contact, something he had meticulously constructed would collapse entirely.嘈杂的人声从窗外传来，是大比报名的最后一天。He took a deep breath, tucked the jade slip into his chest, and turned to push open the door.

Above the Tianqing Sect Martial Arena, a light screen condensed from spiritual energy projected the names of sixty-four disciples. When Chen Ji's name appeared in the thirty-second position, suppressed snickers erupted around him. "How did thistrash not get eliminated in the preliminary rounds?" "Probably someone wants to see him make a fool of himself..." Chen Ji ignored the remarks, his gaze calmly sweeping across the screen. His three opponents were all at the Foundation Building Middle Stage, yet he himself was merely a Foundation Building Initial Stage servant.

dialogue.content: First match, Zhao Tiezhu versus Chen Ji!

text.content: Zhao Tiezhu was infamous in the outer court as a brute, broad-shouldered and thick-bodied, wielding a black iron heavy sword. When he stepped onto the platform, he didn't even glance at Chen Ji, merely saluting the judge's seat: "Elder, this disciple does not wish to waste time. One move to defeat the enemy is sufficient." Chen Ji stood three zhang across from him, eyes lowered and submissive, the picture of a lamb awaiting slaughter. But his divine sense was rapidly operating—Zhao Tiezhu's Qihai point had sluggish spiritual energy flow, and his right knee had an old injury. This was his only opportunity.

choice.prompt: Zhao Tiezhu had already activated his spiritual energy, the heavy sword sweeping forth with the force of wind and thunder! Chen Ji must make a choice—

choices.text: Retreat to advance, feign weakness to lure the enemy
choices.description: Deliberately get knocked back a few steps, exposing a flaw, tempting the opponent to press recklessly, seeking the weakness of the right knee injury
choices.visible_reward: Preserve trump cards, let everyone continue to underestimate
choices.risk_hint: If the enemy does not take the bait, may fall into a grueling battle

text.content: Chen Ji's form flickered, barely evading the heavy sword's edge, yet he "stumbled" backward three steps. Zhao Tiezhu coldly snorted: "Is this all you have?" He strode forward to press the attack, his right knee imperceptibly softening—the old injury acting up at precisely this moment!

choices.text: Activate the Tianji Record to predict
choices.description: Activate the Tianji Record to foresee battle-related scenes within the next three hours, costing 5 Heavenly Fate points
choices.visible_reward: Obtain precise battle foresight, ensuring victory
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate is precious; revealing too early may attract attention from those with ill intentions

text.content: A sharp pain pierced Chen Ji's brow center, and the scene before his eyes suddenly blurred—he saw himself sidestepping the heavy sword, saw his opponent's follow-through causing his right knee to buckle, saw his own fingers precisely striking the Qihai point. Three breaths later, the vision faded. He opened his eyes, the corners of his mouth slightly lifting. "Come then."

Zhao Tiezhu predictably took the bait. As his heavy sword swept wide, his right knee buckled and his form faltered. This was the moment Chen Ji had been waiting for—he pushed off with his toes, his entire person ghosting to his opponent's side like a specter. His fingers flashed like lightning, striking toward the Qihai point. "You—" Zhao Tiezhu's eyes went wide, feeling all his spiritual energy pour out like a breached dam. His knees could no longer support him, and he collapsed to the ground with a thunderous crash. The entire arena erupted in shock. "Chen Ji, victory!" The judge's voice even trembled, clearly not expecting such a result.

dialogue.content: (Murmuring to himself) That finger strike... how did he know the Qihai point's location?

text.content: The second and third matches proceeded in the same manner. Chen Ji played each battle as a narrow victory, yet always found his opponent's fatal weakness at the critical moment. Foundation Building Middle Stage opponents were stripped bare before him, utterly unable to fight back. In just one hour, he had entered the top sixteen. "This Chen Ji... is不对劲." Somewhere in the audience, an Inner Sect Elder narrowed his eyes. "His combat instincts are certainly not those of atrash."

choice.prompt: The top sixteen list was announced, with Chen Ji赫然在列! However, his opponent—Wang Haoran at Foundation Building Peak—was gazing at him with predatory eyes. At this moment, Chen Ji felt exhaustion— that was the backlash from using the Tianji Record. How should he respond?

choices.text: Continue using the Tianji Record for a direct clash
choices.description: Spend another 5 Heavenly Fate points to obtain Wang Haoran's battle trajectory and weaknesses
choices.visible_reward: Perfectly predict opponent's moves, ensuring advancement to top eight
choices.risk_hint: Continuously decreasing Heavenly Fate may affect future plans

text.content: The Tianji Record activated once more, Chen Ji felt as if needles were piercing his brow center. A blurry vision emerged: Wang Haoran's right fist carried the force of thunder and lightning, but his left flank had a nearly one-breath weakness. He opened his eyes, face pale, yet a faint smile appeared. "Enough."

choices.text: Rely on one's own strength for a desperate fight
choices.description: Without depending on the Tianji Record, use observation and on-the-spot reactions to face Foundation Building Peak
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Heavenly Fate, improve combat experience
choices.risk_hint: The gap between Foundation Building Peak and Initial is enormous, victory odds are low

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath,收敛心神. He knew he couldn't defeat Foundation Building Peak through pure strength, but... what if it was merely a matter of stalling for time? His eyes sharpened, fingers slightly curling—that was the precursor to executing the movement technique left by his father—Qingyun Steps.

choices.description: Voluntarily surrender or fake a mistake, preserve strength and Heavenly Fate for more important moments
choices.visible_reward: Preserve all Heavenly Fate, avoid revealing more trump cards
choices.risk_hint: May be permanently labeled astrash by opponents and audience alike

text.content: A barely perceptible cold smile floated at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth. He deliberately exposed a clumsy flaw in battle—if someone were sharp enough, they would notice that flaw was perfectly crafted as if intentionally left. "Chen Ji is defeated!" The moment the judge announced, he felt a sharp gaze pierce over from Su Qingyao's direction. She... had grown suspicious.

However, just as Chen Ji prepared to face battle, an aged yet authoritative voice rang out across the arena: "Wait." Everyone turned to look. Ling Yuan slowly rose from the high platform, those turbid old eyes now blazing with brilliant light. "Chen Ji..." his voice seemed to come from the Nine Abysses, "this old man is very interested in you." Chen Ji's heart tightened. He raised his eyes to clash with that gaze in midair. He felt an unprecedented chill—this old fox had seen through something?

dialogue.content: The rules for the top sixteen bracket were temporarily modified. Chen Ji, your opponent... is changed to this old man's personal disciple, Sun Wujiu.

text.content: Sun Wujiu, Foundation Building Grand Completion, the second genius of the Tianqing Sect Inner Disciple. He slowly descended from the high platform, his gaze like a blade slicing past Chen Ji: "The Master says you're a dark horse, let me see how far this dark horse can run." The whispered discussions throughout the arena abruptly stopped. Everyone was watching Chen Ji, awaiting his reaction—a Foundation Building Initial Stage servant versus a Foundation Building Grand Completion Inner Sect prodigy—this was no longer battle, but a one-sided slaughter. The corner of Ling Yuan's mouth curved into a meaningful arc.

Chen Ji stood motionless, bearing the blade-like gazes from all directions. In his mind, the Tianji Record Fragment pulsed warmly, as if warning him of something. Ling Yuan's move was clearly forcing him to reveal his strength—or be crushed into dust before everyone. Either choice would perfectly serve this scheming sect leader's plans. "Interesting." Chen Ji murmured to himself, voice only audible to himself, "Ling Yuan, you're certainly impatient." He raised his eyes, directly facing the old man on the high platform. Deep in his eyes, a cold light flashed and vanished.

choice.prompt: With a life-and-death showdown imminent, Chen Ji felt unprecedented pressure. Ling Yuan's targeting had become undisguised. He had to make a decision—

choices.text: Activate full foresight of the Tianji Record
choices.description: Without hesitation spend a large amount of Heavenly Fate to obtain complete battle foresight and escape routes
choices.visible_reward: See through everything about the opponent, win while preserving trump cards
choices.risk_hint: Sudden drops in Heavenly Fate may cause unpredictable consequences

text.content: The Tianji Record convulsed violently. Chen Ji felt as if a branding iron was piercing his brow center. In an instant, he saw all of Sun Wujiu's techniques—Thunder Three Strikes, Splitting Sky Palm, and finally that forbidden move, 'Heaven Collapsing Fist.' But he also saw another scene: a talisman hidden in Ling Yuan's sleeve faintly glowing—that was a sealing technique powerful enough to instantly annihilate Foundation Building cultivators!

choices.text: Retreat to advance, surrender on the spot
choices.description: Surrender in front of everyone, letting Ling Yuan lose his excuse for continued targeting
choices.visible_reward: Preserve all Heavenly Fate, temporarily thwarting Ling Yuan's scheme
choices.risk_hint: Thetrash title will be completely solidified, and may be expelled from the sect

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, slowly speaking under the watchful eyes of the entire arena: "This disciple... admits—" Before the words finished, a cold voice interrupted him. "Wait." Su Qingyao stepped forward, "Sect Leader, this is unfair. Chen Ji won three consecutive matches, by the rules, opponents should not be changed midway." Ling Yuan's gaze instantly darkened.

The Martial Arena fell into an eerie silence. Su Qingyao's appearance introduced a variable into Ling Yuan's plans—she was the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, her status not low. If she insisted on obstruction, a public confrontation would benefit no one. The old man's gaze swept between Su Qingyao and Chen Ji, and finally, unexpectedly, he smiled. "Very well." He turned, robes sweeping: "Since the Senior Fellow has objections, we shall proceed according to the rules." Sun Wujiu coldly snorted, but did not refute. His gaze toward Chen Ji, however, grew several degrees colder.

Chen Ji cast Su Qingyao a grateful glance, only to be met with a cold glare in return. "Don't misunderstand." She lowered her voice, "I only dislike watching someone cheat in public. The account between us has not yet been settled." With that, she turned and left, offering Chen Ji only a cold back. He smiled faintly at the corner of his mouth, yet complex emotions stirred in his heart. This woman... was becoming increasingly troublesome.

dialogue.content: (Thinking to himself) Su Qingyao, how much do you really know?

text.content: The crowd gradually dispersed. The official top sixteen bracket was set. Chen Ji's next opponent was a disciple from the Xuanwu Sect, at Foundation Building Late Stage. And his name had finally changed from "trash" to "黑马." But Chen Ji understood clearly that the true crisis had only begun—Ling Yuan had retreated today, yet the malice hidden deep within those turbid old eyes was more terrifying than any attack. He gripped the jade slip in his chest, feeling his father's lingering aura slightly fluctuating.

That night, Chen Ji returned alone to his decrepit courtyard. He took out the Tianji Record Fragment and gazed at the familiar characters. Mo Xiansheng's shadow flickered intermittently on the fragment: "Today you used the Tianji Record four times, consuming twenty Heavenly Fate points." Chen Ji furrowed his brow: "Was it worth it?" Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment: "If it could temporarily cause Ling Yuan to hold back, it was worth it. But..." He paused, "What this old man fears more is that you've begun to depend on this power." Chen Ji gave no answer, only tucking the fragment back into his chest. Moonlight filtered through the window lattice, illuminating the fathomless cold light in his eyes.
